fact: On 26 May 2022 at Ouesso the Congolese and Central African ministers launched works on the Congo-CAR fibre link, and the Congo-Cameroon fibre link was provisionally received, both under the CAB project, following a cooperation accord on interconnection signed in Bangui on 6 August 2019.
title: Intégration en zone Cémac : le Congo, le Cameroun et la Centrafrique écrivent les pages de leur interconnexion par fibre optique avec le projet CAB
